metadata.scope: Approximate fixed-pair necessary-count calculations, not certified interval bounds, global optima, achievable sample sizes, or measurements.
metadata.optimizer_diagnostics_scope: Termination statuses, iteration counts and evaluation counts describe this execution and can vary across platforms even with pinned library versions. They are not reproducibility thresholds or certificates of global optimality; retained candidates are evaluated separately.

design.E1_scope: bounded integer search, global optimum not certified; cap hits excluded
design.E2_domain: continuous M>=1, 0<p<=1; exact rational sign and domain guards; inferred background is diagnostic only
design.E3_domain: continuous M>=1, 0<p<=1, background>=0; exact rational guards
design.E2_background_diagnostics: evaluated whenever cumulant signs permit; negative includes p/M failures; negative_among_successful counts retained estimates
design.summary_scope: conditional on success; raw finite summaries also retained; no empirical thresholds gate CI
design.quantiles: Q25, median, Q75; numpy.quantile method=linear; conditional on the same successes as the mean/RMSE
design.E2_reporting: median and interquartile range are primary; mean and RMSE are unstable tail diagnostics, not reliable typical-error summaries
